text: Campers employ lanterns to illuminate their path while hiking through dark trails at night. These lanterns serve as a dependable source of light, crucial for ensuring safety and navigation. Furthermore, lanterns are a valuable addition to camping equipment, as they can be used for various purposes, including storytelling, music, and decoration. Although the trails are naturally illuminated, the additional light from the lanterns enhances the camping experience, making it more enjoyable and serene.
